panels.description: Keel pump hall before dawn. Alex tests an aging pump by touch; a salvaged bracket replaces the approved part, a white-and-amber node logs his shift and a supervisor watches. Leave upper-left and upper-right machinery space clear for dialogue.

Alex touches an exit checkpoint scanner while workers queue behind him. The display occupies the center and remains large and legible. Reserve separate zones: upper-left for the debt-transfer caption, upper-right for the guard balloon, center-left for the debt and clearance facts, lower-right for Alex’s reply, and bottom-left for the closing caption. Keep every lettering zone outside Alex’s face and the display’s main figures.

Keel street: Alex passes the shuttered LAST CHANCE casino while a bouncer leans in the doorway; a small rationed water queue is visible across the street without recognisable faces. Leave upper-left and upper-right open for the bouncer’s two lines.

Empty pump hall and terminal. The unauthorized-repair alert, routine-maintenance selection and site-credit entry appear as three clearly separated horizontal interface rows. Leave lower-right open for the supervisor’s balloon and keep all rows readable.
At sunrise on the exhausted pit rim, Alex faces Oasis while Keel remains in shadow. Keep the restricted status display visible and leave lower-left open for his line.

items.text: Then don't approve it. Just notice it works.
